blocks.text: Transgenic janwar matloob protein banane ke liye bairooni gene rakhta hai. Transgenic janwar dawaen banane, paidawar barhane aur bimari ke khilaf muzahimat barhane ke liye use hote hain, maslan:

items: Insani genes wali transgenic doodh deti gaaen; kitab kehti hai ke un ka doodh insani maa ke doodh jaisa hai, halanke aisi gaaen sirf kuch insani doodh ke proteins banati hain.
Transgenic bakriyan jin ke doodh mein makri ke resham jaise mazboot proteins hain.
Transgenic bakriyan jin ke doodh mein insani enzyme lysozyme hai jo dast paida karne wale bacteria se larta hai.
Transgenic machhliyan behtar barhotri, kam khurak, zyada sardi bardasht aur bimari ki muzahimat ke saath.
Gene therapy jis mein genetically modified viruses insanon tak genes pohancha kar moroosi bimariyon, jaise T aur B cells ki kharab nashonuma aur moroosi andhapan, ka ilaaj karte hain.
Transgenic bakri se pehli insani dawa, aik anticoagulant jo operation ya zachgi mein khoon jamne ka imkaan kam karta hai.
Laboratory mein bane malaria se mehfooz machhar jin mein aisa gene hai jo un mein Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baatein
blocks.text: Nazariyati taur par bairooni genes insanon ke germline ya somatic cells mein dale ja sakte hain. Germline cells ki tabdeeliyan virasat mein jaati, is liye khatraat aur akhlaqi masail ki wajah se zyada tehqeeq somatic cells par hui hai. 1980s ke wast se transgenic chuhe bimariyon ki tehqeeq ka ahem model hain kyunke un ka genome poori tarah parha ja chuka aur insani genome se bohat milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Insani gene tehqeeq zyada tar germline ke bajaye somatic cells par kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Germline tabdeeliyan aane wali naslon tak jaati, jis se khatraat aur akhlaqi masail paida hote; somatic tabdeeliyan sirf ilaaj wale shakhs par asar karti hain.

items: Transgenic janwar: doodh mein dawaen, resham proteins, tez barhne wali machhliyan, malaria se mehfooz machhar.
Gene therapy badle hue viruses use karti; tehqeeq somatic cells par.
Transgenic chuhe insani bimari ka model.
